O.outcome_detail: learning to control variables during investigations

result.effect: explicit rule teaching: g = 0.58, 95% CI = 0.46–0.70; rules not explicitly taught: g = 0.65, 95% CI = 0.51–0.79

cells.quote: In contrast with findings from single intervention studies (e.g., Chen & Klahr, 1999; Klahr & Nigam, 2004) we found studies that explicitly taught a CVS rule to have effect sizes (g = 0.58, 95% CI = 0.46–0.70) no different from studies in which CVS rules were not explicitly taught (g = 0.65, 95% CI = 0.51–0.79). (p. 54)
